gates.reason: Inspected source-route and server-boundary coverage: unknown source IDs are rejected, temporary roots are isolated, and LLM/token environment variables are explicitly disabled.
Route-contract test; it defines no detector, recommendation, or calculation claim.
One-shot integration harness, not production hot-path code or a new unprobed surface.
Cache unit tests do not handle authentication, filesystem paths, commands, secrets, or client rendering.
Inspected reproducible assertions for stale-state rejection, ABA-state handling, retry behavior, and cache-entry consistency.
Covers single-flight behavior, warm-hit avoidance of rebuilds, independent keys, and bounded LRU eviction.
Inspected SPA/server-boundary checks: missing assets cannot fall through to HTML, shell responses are no-store, and test server secrets/LLM toggles are cleared.
Static HTTP contract test; no detector, parser, recommendation, or arithmetic claim.
Verifies immutable year-long caching for assets while preventing stale SPA-shell caching.

Inspected filesystem writes and egress posture: output roots are explicit CLI destinations, parsed task IDs are restricted to safe slug characters by the directly related parser, and the endpoint is in-process with no external egress.
Both arms use the same offline scorer, failures remain failures, and output records carry an ISO as-of value plus endpointKind='scripted' to prevent overclaiming live evidence.
Host-only offline evaluation CLI, not request-path or client-bundle code.
All filesystem and database writes target random temporary fixture paths; SQL lookup uses a bound parameter.
Inspected round-trip, byte-length, hash, unchanged-ingest, targeted-invalidation, and strict-JSON assertions; calculations are derived directly from stored artifacts.
Verifies lazy BLOB materialization and zero transcript rewrites for unchanged incremental ingest.
Read-only compression-policy test with no security boundary or sensitive-data handling.
Compression tuning test does not define recommendation or parser-output claims.
Provides an explicit probe requiring fast Brotli quality, a size hint, and exclusion of quality 11.

Inspected supply-chain/runtime boundary enforcement: server-runtime bare-package imports are blocked while built-ins, URLs, tests, and explicitly isolated loader/shim parents are handled deliberately.
Module-resolution loader; no detector, recommendation, parser result, or calculation.
Resolution performs only a fixed three-candidate existence check per eligible extensionless relative import.
Fixture writes remain under random temporary roots, the zip is generated from deterministic in-process fixture entries, and cleanup targets only those resolved fixture/database paths.
Inspected exact cross-pipeline parity checks, explicit provenance/field normalization, exhaustive dataset-key classification, deterministic sorting, and failure on unclassified divergence.
Offline parity harness, not upload production-path implementation or a performance-budget probe.
Filesystem activity is confined to random temporary fixture roots and no commands, network requests, or credentials are used.
Re-derived the asserted 150-token total as 100+30+7+13 and inspected discovery, attribution, idempotence, and skip-cap evidence.
Includes probes for merged-part, project-directory, and top-level session-discovery caps.
Discovery accepts only actual directory/file dirents, skips symlinked run directories, and includes only agent-*.jsonl files beneath the supplied workflows root.
Enumeration is deterministically sorted, excludes journal/meta files, and reports truncation instead of silently presenting capped discovery as complete.
Provides bounded directory reads and output limits without per-entry stat calls; callers can detect truncation.
